expected: ISO TABLES sheet may contain RT rate tables referenced by the PR ROC rating program
actual: Sheet skipped. Investigation (Wave 4): sheet contains stacked rate tables (e.g. 'Rule 85 BG1 Class Loss Costs') with Construction/ContentType/Value structure — NO 'RATE TABLE ID' or 'RATE TABLE NAME' markers that parseRtTables() requires. The table name is in col B (not col A), and there is no standardized block marker. Implementing a new parser for this format would require (a) unknown block-delimiter heuristic, (b) no connecting reference between the PROPERTY ROC step 'TABLE REFERENCE' column and the ISO TABLES block names, and (c) no safe way to attribute which ROC step uses which ISO TABLE row. Risk of fabrication is high.
blockedReason: After 1 attempt: ISO TABLES uses a non-standard flat matrix format with no RATE TABLE ID/NAME markers. Extending parseRtTables() for this format requires a new block-detection heuristic AND a mapping between ROC step TABLE REFERENCE values and ISO TABLE titles — neither is consistently present. Fabricating the linkage would violate the no-fabrication invariant.
